defmodule UploadProcessor.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:urlencoded, :multipart],
    pass: ["*/*"],
    length: 10_000_000
  plug :dispatch

  @upload_dir "/tmp/uploads"
  @allowed_extensions ~w(.png .jpg .jpeg .gif .pdf)

  # Allowlist of metadata tools and their permitted flags (fixes CWE-78)
  @allowed_metadata_tools %{
    "exiftool" => ~w(-all -json -s),
    "file" => ~w(--mime-type -b)
  }

  post "/upload" do
    case conn.params do
      %{"file" => %Plug.Upload{} = upload} ->
        result = process_upload(upload, conn.params)
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", result: result}))
      _ ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "No file provided"}))
    end
  end

  post "/transform" do
    case conn.params do
      %{"file_id" => file_id, "operations" => ops_json} ->
        operations = Jason.decode!(ops_json)
        result = apply_transforms(file_id, operations)
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", result: result}))
      _ ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Missing parameters"}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found")
  end

  defp process_upload(%Plug.Upload{filename: filename, path: tmp_path}, params) do
    ext = Path.extname(filename) |> String.downcase()
    unless ext in @allowed_extensions do
      raise "Invalid file extension: #{ext}"
    end

    file_id = generate_file_id()
    dest_path = Path.join(@upload_dir, "#{file_id}#{ext}")
    File.cp!(tmp_path, dest_path)

    metadata = extract_metadata(dest_path, params)
    store_metadata(file_id, metadata)
    %{file_id: file_id, metadata: metadata}
  end

  defp extract_metadata(file_path, params) do
    base_meta = %{
      size: File.stat!(file_path).size,
      uploaded_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    }

    case Map.get(params, "extract_with") do
      nil -> base_meta
      extractor -> run_extractor(extractor, file_path, base_meta)
    end
  end

  defp run_extractor(extractor_spec, file_path, base_meta) do
    {mod_name, func_name} = parse_extractor_spec(extractor_spec)
    module = resolve_module(mod_name)
    function = String.to_existing_atom(func_name)

    case apply(module, function, [file_path, base_meta]) do
      {:ok, enriched} -> Map.merge(base_meta, enriched)
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Extractor failed: #{reason}")
        base_meta
    end
  end

  defp parse_extractor_spec(spec) when is_binary(spec) do
    case String.split(spec, ".", parts: 2) do
      [mod, func] -> {mod, func}
      _ -> {"DefaultExtractor", "extract"}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_module(mod_name) do
    # Security: only allow modules from our extractors namespace
    full_name = "Elixir.UploadProcessor.Extractors.#{mod_name}"
    String.to_existing_atom(full_name)
  end

  defp apply_transforms(file_id, operations) when is_list(operations) do
    file_path = locate_file(file_id)

    Enum.reduce(operations, %{path: file_path, log: []}, fn op, acc ->
      execute_operation(op, acc)
    end)
  end

  defp execute_operation(%{"type" => "resize", "args" => args}, acc) do
    chain = build_command_chain("convert", args, acc.path)
    {output, 0} = System.cmd("sh", ["-c", chain])
    %{acc | log: acc.log ++ [output]}
  end

  defp execute_operation(%{"type" => "metadata", "args" => args}, acc) do
    tool = Map.get(args, "tool", "exiftool")
    flags = Map.get(args, "flags", "-all")

    allowed_flags = Map.get(@allowed_metadata_tools, tool)

    unless allowed_flags && flags in allowed_flags do
      raise "Unauthorized metadata tool or flag: #{tool} #{flags}"
    end

    {output, _} = System.cmd(tool, [flags, acc.path])
    %{acc | log: acc.log ++ [output]}
  end

  defp execute_operation(%{"type" => "pipeline", "chain" => chain_spec}, acc) do
    result = evaluate_pipeline(chain_spec, acc)
    %{acc | log: acc.log ++ [result]}
  end

  defp execute_operation(_, acc), do: acc

  defp evaluate_pipeline(chain_spec, acc) when is_list(chain_spec) do
    chain_spec
    |> Enum.map(fn step ->
      case step do
        %{"module" => m, "function" => f, "args" => a} ->
          mod = resolve_pipeline_module(m)
          func = String.to_existing_atom(f)
          resolved_args = Enum.map(a, &resolve_arg(&1, acc))
          apply(mod, func, resolved_args)
        _ ->
          {:error, "unsupported pipeline step"}
      end
    end)
    |> List.last()
  end

  @allowed_pipeline_modules [
    "UploadProcessor.Extractors.ImageInfo",
    "UploadProcessor.Extractors.DefaultExtractor",
    "UploadProcessor.Transforms.Resize",
    "UploadProcessor.Transforms.Crop"
  ]

  defp resolve_pipeline_module(mod_name) do
    unless mod_name in @allowed_pipeline_modules do
      raise "Unauthorized module in pipeline: #{mod_name}"
    end
    String.to_existing_atom("Elixir." <> mod_name)
  end

  defp resolve_arg("$path", acc), do: acc.path
  defp resolve_arg("$log", acc), do: acc.log
  defp resolve_arg(arg, _acc), do: arg

  defp build_command_chain(base_cmd, %{"width" => w, "height" => h}, path) do
    w_safe = sanitize_dimension(w)
    h_safe = sanitize_dimension(h)
    path_safe = Regex.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/.]/, path, "")
    "#{base_cmd} #{path_safe} -resize #{w_safe}x#{h_safe} #{path_safe}_resized"
  end

  defp build_command_chain(base_cmd, _, path) do
    path_safe = Regex.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/.]/, path, "")
    "#{base_cmd} #{path_safe} #{path_safe}_copy"
  end

  defp sanitize_dimension(dim) when is_integer(dim) and dim > 0 and dim <= 10000 do
    Integer.to_string(dim)
  end
  defp sanitize_dimension(dim) when is_binary(dim) do
    case Integer.parse(dim) do
      {n, ""} when n > 0 and n <= 10000 -> Integer.to_string(n)
      _ -> raise "Invalid dimension"
    end
  end

  defp locate_file(file_id) do
    safe_id = Regex.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, file_id, "")
    pattern = Path.join(@upload_dir, "#{safe_id}.*")
    case Path.wildcard(pattern) do
      [path | _] -> path
      [] -> raise "File not found: #{safe_id}"
    end
  end

  defp generate_file_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end

  defp store_metadata(file_id, metadata) do
    :ets.insert(:upload_metadata, {file_id, metadata})
  end
end

defmodule UploadProcessor.Extractors.ImageInfo do
  def extract(file_path, _base_meta) do
    case System.cmd("file", ["--mime-type", file_path]) do
      {output, 0} -> {:ok, %{mime_type: String.trim(output)}}
      {_, _} -> {:error, "Failed to detect mime type"}
    end
  end
end

defmodule UploadProcessor.Extractors.DefaultExtractor do
  def extract(_file_path, _base_meta) do
    {:ok, %{}}
  end
end
